title: Nametags that can be crafted
description: This Datapack adds a cheap recipe to make nametags craftable, requiring just paper & string!
body:
# Craftable Nametags!
This Datapack adds a cheap recipe to Minecraft to make nametags craftable, requiring just paper & string!

The reason I made this datapack is because it's so STUPID that we can't craft nametags. Like, imagine if you couldn't craft leads or fishing rods! So anyways, Since no one wants to go exploring for two hours just to find a nametag so we can nametag a mob I just made nametags craftable!
